description: React component for configuring Single Sign-On (SSO) providers including Azure, Google, Auth0, and Github. It manages state, fetches existing configurations, validates inputs, and handles testing and saving of SSO settings.

methods.name: validateAzureFields
methods.description: Validates Azure configuration fields, adding errors if any required fields are blank.

methods.name: validateGoogleFields
methods.description: Validates Google configuration fields, adding errors if any required fields are blank.

methods.name: validateGithubFields
methods.description: Validates Github configuration fields, adding errors if any required fields are blank.

methods.name: validateAuth0Fields
methods.description: Validates Auth0 configuration fields, adding errors if any required fields are blank.

methods.name: validateFields
methods.description: Aggregates validation for all enabled providers and resets error state.

methods.name: constructRequestBody
methods.description: Builds the payload object for updating or testing SSO configurations based on current state.

methods.name: validateAndSubmit
methods.description: Validates inputs, then submits the SSO configuration update request, showing success or error notifications.

methods.name: validateAndTest
methods.description: Validates inputs for a specific provider, then tests the configuration, showing success or error notifications.

methods.name: getSelectedProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently selected provider based on tab index.

search-terms: React hooks for API and state
